_comment: Bypass profile for Roblox game servers. Roblox was blocked in RF on 2025-12-03; the website loads over HTTPS (domain) but joining a place is raw UDP to game-server IPs (ports 49152-65535, no SNI), so a domain bypass cannot touch it. This profile (from Flowseal's RobloxFix) desyncs the Roblox game-server IP ranges directly via --ipset-ip. Edit this file to update IP ranges when Roblox adds new subnets — no rebuild needed: the app reads it at every launch.
_comment_2: Placeholders like %BIN%/%LISTS% are NOT expanded here — the args are tokenized and merged into the selected strategy via combine_with_roblox() which already resolves placeholders at save/launch time.
description: Специальный профиль для Roblox: обход игровых серверов по IP (UDP 49152-65535) + сайт по доменам. Запускайте её, когда играете в Roblox.
